title: Plan, define the check, do, check
sub: The fifth film of Agents at work on data, the second series on AI agents in data work: before an agent starts, a person sets the goal, what it reads, the tools it may use, what it must never do, and how its result will be checked; the agent builds, tests and documents, with evidence for every claim; a person checks it against the plan and answers for it; and each loop leaves something for the next.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, violet the model, orange the data coming back, green a check that passes, amber one that fails, or a loop. The scenes of Singapore, 1998 to 2003, are painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and year on a tag.
